title: Response Refinement Chains
summary: This module provides chains for refining LLM responses, including applying constitutional principles for ethical and quality control, and self-verifying summarization for accuracy.

nodes.label: ConstitutionalChain
nodes.title: Constitutional AI Chain
nodes.description: Orchestrates the iterative refinement of LLM responses using constitutional principles, critiquing and revising outputs.

nodes.label: LLMSummarizationCheckerChain
nodes.title: LLM Summarization Checker
nodes.description: Manages the self-verification and revision of LLM-generated summaries for accuracy by creating and checking assertions.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: LLM
nodes.description: The underlying Large Language Model used for generation, critique, assertion creation, checking, and revision tasks.

nodes.label: Initial LLM Output
nodes.title: Initial LLM Output
nodes.description: The raw text (response or summary) generated by an LLM that requires refinement or verification.

nodes.label: Constitutional Principles
nodes.title: Principles
nodes.description: User-defined rules or guidelines (e.g., ethical, safety, style) used to steer the refinement process.

nodes.label: Refined Response
nodes.title: Refined Response
nodes.description: The final LLM response after being processed and refined by the ConstitutionalChain.

nodes.label: Verified Summary
nodes.title: Verified Summary
nodes.description: The summary text after undergoing self-verification and revision to ensure accuracy.

groups.label: Constitutional AI Refinement
groups.title: Constitutional AI Refinement
groups.description: A process for enhancing LLM outputs by applying ethical or quality principles through iterative critique and revision.

groups.label: Self-Verifying Summarization
groups.title: Self-Verifying Summarization
groups.description: An iterative method to improve summary accuracy by generating and checking assertions, then revising the summary.
